description: Answers whether a given investor profile can buy or hold one UNIALL asset, and why. Combines sourced offering rules with the on-chain transferability oracle. Returns ELIGIBLE | NOT_ELIGIBLE | REQUIRES_ONBOARDING | UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN when rules are missing or older than 90 days. Informational only.
name: check_eligibility

answer.description: Short natural-language summary of the result.

assets.description: Matched assets when applicable (find_assets). Empty or omitted for stats/summary tools.

disclaimer.description: Fixed data-only disclaimer; not investment advice.

facts.description: Sourced scalar facts. Each item has field, value, source_url, source_type, as_of.

title: Check investor eligibility
